set.body: Resolve recorded context-holder candidates through verified text identity classes without changing account IDs. Distinguish no candidate, unresolved candidate, several identities and unprocessed work; preserve context placement. Account/document/evidence binding, API/CLI construction-to-consumer example, adversarial tests, independent review. Full context vocabulary, first-person identity consumption, playback and assessment integration remain subsequent required work.
set.title: P2 checked context holder resolution and situation inspection
